import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, m, M, N):
        M = np.asarray(M, dtype=np.float64)
        N = np.asarray(N, dtype=np.float64)
        assert np.ndim(m) == 0
        assert M.shape == (m, m)
        assert N.shape == (m, m)
        self.ret = M + N
